content.text: Geb degine, Bab-Dummad ibagugledgi (7) ise-nued binsasad.

content: Deyob napneg obinnilesad, degi, nibneg obinnilesad. 1b. Dule abirgunagwar Edénʼgi gwisgunonikid (2:4-25) Dule-abirgunagwar-gwisgunonikid Bab-Dummad-Jehová, we-napneg, degi, nibneg obinnisgua,
amba sapimar napneggi sated, amba yoo gaganmar-aragana ainidabalid. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová amba yoo dii napagi owidaged, degi, dule napagi-arbaega satebalid.
Unnila napagi dii-bupurmakmaid, bergwapa napa ogegar.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová napa susgu, a-napagi dule-sobsad. Bab-Jehová dule-sobsagu, dule-asugi buu imaksad. Geb agi, dule burba-nika gunonikid. Agine, dule dula-gunonisunnad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová dad-nakwedsik, Edénʼgi nainu-nued nasiksad. Agi, Bab-Dummad-Jehová we-dule-obinnisad ogwisnonikid.

Agine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová sapimar akar-akar bela yeerdaklemalad ainiega imaksad. A-sapimar-e-san bela yeer-gulle imaksad. Nainu-nued-abargi, sapi-wargwen gwichid. Dule we-sapi-e-san guchale, dula-gudii guoed, gwen burgosulid. Degine, sapi-baid gwichibalid. Dule we-sapi-e-san guchardina, wisguoed, ibu ibnuedi, ibu ib-isganabali.
Degine, Edénʼgi diwar maid. Agi, e-saila-siid. A-diwar nainu-nued ogmaid. A-diwar ana-sogabake nikad.
Gebe-ana-gwensakgadi Pisónʼye nugad. A-diwar bela Havila-yalaganba bipirmakmaid. Aginbali, a-yargi or nikad.
Havila-yargine or-nikadi, or-nuedid. Agi sapi-nued-gichi-nikad-bedelioʼye-nugad nikad. Degi, akwa-nued-óniceʼye-nugad nikabalid.
Diwar-ana-sogbogwaddi Gihón-diwarye nugad. A-diwar bela Cus-yalaganba bipirmakmaimogad.
Diwar-ana-sogapaagwaddi Hidekelʼye nugad. A-diwar, Asiria-dad-nakwedsik maid. Diwar-sogabakegwaddi Éufratesʼye nugad.
Nainu-nued-Edén-akwega, Bab-Dummad-Jehová, dule-ogwisnonikid, agi arbaegar.
Agine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová dulega igar-uksad: “We-nainu-nuedgi sapimar-bukwad-e-sanmar sunna bela be gunned.
Unnila sapi-wargwen-e-sandi melle be gunno. We-sapi, ibmar-nued-wisi, ibmar-isgana-wisi dule-saed. A-sapi-e-san be guchale, a-ibagi be burgoed.”
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová sogded: “Dule wargwen-gudiir, akuu dakleged. Degisoggu, dulega e-abirgined an imakoed, adi, e-bendaked-nuedga guegar.”

Bab-Dummad-Jehová napagi bela ibmar-durgan, bela nuumar obinnisad. Bab-Jehová we-ibdurganmala Adánʼse senonikid. Adi, Adán ega nug amiegar. Dule ibmar-durganga nug-amisad, abali, ibmar-durgan nugnanaed.
Weyobi dule bela we-ibmar-durgan:
Degi-inigwele, Adánʼgardi e-bendaked sate gusad.
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová Adán-ise-nue-gabega imaksad. Adán nue-gabmaigu, Bab-Jehová Adán-e-dikargar-wargwen onosad. Geb Bab-Dummad-Jehová gannar Adán-e-san edisad.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová we-dikargargi ome-obinnisad. Agi, macheredga ome-senonikid.
Adán ome-dakdegu, sogded:

content.text: “Ar wedi an-galado, ar ade, an-gargi obinnilealedid.
Wedi an-sanado, ar ade, an-sangi obinnilealedid.

content: A-ulale, machered e-babgi bangudoed, e-nangi bangudoed. Geb machered e-ome-ebo garmakdii guoed. Ebogwadi, san-wargwennagwadga gunonikoed.
Deunni, Adán, Eva-ebogwa, uka-swili garmakdimalad, gwen binged nikasurmalad.
